reviews.title: STARZ Needs to Fix the App
reviews.text: Very disappointed with the STARZ app. I have Hulu, Disney+, Netflix, HBO, and Amazon Prime, and none of those apps have this problem. Every time I leave the STARZ app, even for something as simple as a battery warning popping up, the episode continues playing but the app goes back to the main screen. When I go back to the episode, it shows “Continue Watching,” but it will not let me hit play and actually continue watching. The only way I can get back to the episode is to completely close the STARZ app, reopen it, start the entire episode over from the beginning, and then fast-forward all the way back to where I was. This happens every time and is extremely frustrating. Every other streaming service I use remembers exactly where I stopped and lets me continue watching without a problem. I subscribed mainly to watch Outlander and Blood of My Blood, and as soon as I finish them, I will be canceling my STARZ subscription. The shows are great, but the app is frustrating enough that I don’t want to keep paying for it.

reviews.title: STARZ App Needs Significant Accessibility Improvements for Blind and Low Vision Users
reviews.text:
As a Blind/Low Vision customer, I am disappointed that the STARZ app is not fully accessible. Accessibility is not a luxury—it’s a necessity for millions of people who rely on screen readers and other assistive technologies to independently access digital content.

Throughout the app, there are unlabeled buttons, controls that are not properly identified by screen readers, and navigation elements that can be difficult or impossible to use without sight. Certain features lack appropriate accessibility labels, making it challenging to browse content, manage account settings, and fully enjoy the streaming experience.

For a major streaming platform, I expect accessibility to be built into the user experience from the beginning, not treated as an afterthought. Blind and Low Vision customers pay the same subscription fees as everyone else and deserve equal access to all features and content offered by the service.

I strongly encourage STARZ to work with Blind and Low Vision users, accessibility professionals, and assistive technology testers to identify and resolve these barriers. Improvements such as proper screen reader support, clearly labeled buttons, accessible navigation, consistent focus management, and ongoing accessibility testing would make a significant difference.

Until meaningful accessibility improvements are made, I cannot recommend the STARZ app to other Blind or Low Vision users who depend on accessible technology for independent access.

Rating: 2 out of 5 star
